topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 21 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 3 ERC20 tokens, 3 Chainlink feeds; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (owned, simplewriteaccesscontroller, typeandversioninterface). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.

audits.report_name: **Designed by Maple, in partnership with leading 3rd parties**: The team at Room40 are experts in trading treasuries and will trade, custody and clear from an account with a regulated broker.
